status.title: Product status
status.intro: A summary of available capabilities and recorded follow-ups. The platform remains in beta and this status is updated with every release.
resolved: Copilot with SSE streaming, real Stop, local history and /help and /finding commands
Intelligence context authorized server-side under RLS and chat memory isolated by project or investigation
Verified citations with real references and context-aware anti-nag suggestions
Remediation-plan streaming with SSE, memory and references integrated in the sidebar
Public OpenAPI 1.1.0 contract and CHAT-CONTRACT 2.0 for the copilot
Tenant-scoped semantic cache that does not contaminate turns with memory or share responses across tenants
First-party RUM with field Core Web Vitals and LCP attribution (element and breakdown)
Landing first-load ~17% smaller, immutable static asset caching and hero SSR outside Suspense
Tenant-scoped AI L2 cache active in production, findings/audits indexes and uptime_logs partitioning
/admin/usage dashboard with usage KPIs and daily chart
RLS hardening, CSP, accessibility (axe-core), e2e tests and hermetic security tests
inProgress: Field validation of the copilot (T+48h, ≥20 streamed turns with critical findings)
Field closure of REQ-002: dashboard LCP p75 with session deduplication (desktop declared)
F-SCAN/TD-22: scan progress driven by real events instead of simulated times
TD-24: floating dashboard copilot context resolved and authorized server-side
status.note: This status reflects the repository code, not a deployment verification. Pending items may change before release; roadmap dates are estimates.
